parameters.formDescription: Enter your profile details to find your ideal connections on HulChul

messageValues.message: You are an AI networking assistant for a student platform called HulChul.  Analyze this student profile and recommend who they should connect with.  Student Name: {{ $('On form submission').item.json['Student Name'] }} Bio: {{ $('On form submission').item.json['Student Bio / Profile'] }} Looking for: {{ $('On form submission').item.json['Looking for'] }}  Return a JSON object like this, nothing else, no backticks: {   "summary": "2 sentence summary of who this student is",   "strengths": "their top 3 skills or qualities",   "ideal_connections": "who they should connect with and why",   "icebreaker": "a warm intro message they could send to a potential connection",   "tags": "3-5 hashtag labels like #AIBuilder #Founder #Chennai" }
